correctness.rationale: Independently implemented complete binary prefix extension with exhaustive suffix-cube rejection and length-six complement-pair rejection. Both constraints are factorial; every forbidden newly created cube terminates at the newly appended bit, and every newly formed complementary pair of length at least six has a forbidden complementary length-six prefix. The independently obtained survivor counts for lengths 0..51 exactly equal the stated 52-term list; at length 50 there are 16 distinct words and at length 51 none. The complete equality set is preserved by bit complement and reversal, splitting into four disjoint size-four orbits. I compared actual RESULT.md and both engines in verify.py; complete prefix recursion proves exhaustion, not only sampled word checks. The published length-50 upper bound is explicitly prior work.
